materialization_rules.acquisition_recipe_mapping: The curator acquisition_recipe_or_snapshot_ref is represented by each manifest acquisition_url plus the fetch_recipe_only distribution boundary; the stale helper script is not authority.
materialization_rules.document_version_rule: sha256: followed by the first 12 lowercase hexadecimal characters of content_sha256

header_sanitization.original_header_identity_rule: Retain each original staging SHA-256 and byte length in the report; exclude all original response-header bytes and all sensitive values.

materialization_rules.header_value_source: Exact redirect, ETag, Last-Modified, media-type, and charset assertions were transcribed from the hash-bound independent SOURCE-INVENTORY.json; no new HTTP observation is claimed.
materialization_rules.license_inventory_rule: Every per-source manifest license block must exactly match the canonical repository license inventory entry with the same source_id.

timestamp_rule.operation: truncate fractional seconds to the preceding whole second

materialization_rules.whatwg_basis_mapping: The original curator present-tense redistribution statement remains in curator/SOURCE-INVENTORY.json and curator/LICENSE-INVENTORY.md. The canonical recipe-only manifest renders it conditionally because this repository distributes no source response body.

excluded: All raw and replay standards bytes
All original unsanitized HTTP response-header bytes and sensitive header values
All labels, gold records, split membership, predictions, scores, and acceptance outputs
included: Canonical acquisition recipes with exact official URLs, prior response headers, content SHA-256 values, byte lengths, adapter identities, and license bases
Exact independent curation inventory, report, and license inventory bytes plus the hash identity of their partial historical checksum file
Twenty-seven hash-linked sanitized source, replay, license, policy, and chain-evidence HTTP header records plus their original-to-sanitized identity map
